page_title: Let's build a URL shortener in Go - Part I

summary.title: Let's build a URL shortener in Go - Part I
summary.one_liner: You learn how to set up a Go project with Redis and Gin dependencies and run a first smoke-test web server for a URL shortener.
takeaways: Initialize a Go module (requires Go 1.11+) and verify it with a simple main.go program.
Install the go-redis v8 and Gin web framework dependencies.
Start a Gin web server on localhost:9808 and check that it returns a JSON message.
Redis is used as the storage layer for fast data retrieval; it must be installed locally to follow later parts.
summary.summary: This is Part I of a tutorial series on building a URL shortener in Go, using Redis for storage. The article covers project setup: initializing a Go module, creating a main.go smoke test, and installing the go-redis v8 and Gin dependencies. It then starts a Gin web server and checks that a JSON response is returned from an endpoint on port 9808. The page is brief and says later parts will follow.
